page.layout: One spine of a bound book: a red title label with three gilt lines at the top, a gilt ornament in the middle, and a library label with shelf mark at the foot. Only the title label is printed matter; the shelf label is left out.
page.notes: Spine of the binding, not a text page. The gilt title is transcribed; a short rule separates the first two lines. Left out as not printed matter: the library label ("Bc 2888", "BIBLIOTHEQUE PUBLIQUE"), the gilt ornament, and the gilt bands. The first line may read "DE CHANDIEU" in a worn form; no letters were doubtful enough to mark with [?].
